d: We are looking for an experienced, organized, and results-driven Management Services Manager to oversee and coordinate administrative and management support functions, ensure operational efficiency, and facilitate effective organizational processes.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing support services, streamlining administrative operations, developing management procedures, monitoring departmental performance, and ensuring that organizational resources and services are effectively utilized.
The successful candidate should have strong leadership, planning, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across departments and support organizational objectives.
Oversee and manage day-to-day management services and administrative support operations.
Develop, implement, and monitor administrative policies, procedures, and operational guidelines.
Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth business operations and effective service delivery.
Monitor departmental activities, service standards, and operational performance against defined objectives.
Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvement initiatives.
Manage organizational resources, facilities, office services, and administrative requirements effectively.
Develop and maintain management reports, operational dashboards, and performance summaries.
Support senior management in business planning, organizational coordination, and operational decision-making.
Ensure effective communication and coordination between management and departmental teams.
Monitor budgets, administrative expenses, and resource utilization to support cost efficiency.
Establish performance standards and service-level expectations for management support functions.
Oversee vendor coordination, procurement support, and service provider relationships where required.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Identify operational risks and recommend appropriate corrective and preventive measures.
Lead, guide, and develop management services and administrative support staff.
Prepare periodic reports and presentations highlighting operational performance, challenges, and improvement opportunities.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management Sciences, Public Administration, or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA will be an advantage.
4–6 years of relevant experience in Management Services, Administration, Operations Management, or a similar role.
Proven experience in managing administrative functions and coordinating cross-functional operations.
Strong knowledge of organizational management, operational planning, and process improvement.
Excellent leadership, team management, and decision-making skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Experience with ERP systems, management reporting tools, or workflow management platforms is preferred.
Strong budgeting, resource allocation, and cost-control capabilities.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within deadlines.
High level of professionalism, accountability, and attention to detail.
Leadership opportunity with exposure to organizational management.
Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to operational excellence and process improvement.

Our team consists of 25,000 colleagues, spread across 35 countries. We believe in transformation – embracing agile and new ways of working together, which helps us to truly ‘think client’ and serve millions of our affluent and emerging affluent clients, across the world. Our clients include individuals and small businesses, and we support them with a range of traditional banking services, including investment, credit and wealth planning solutions.
We offer career opportunities for relationship managers, customer service specialists, product and segment management, sales and wealth planning.
If you’re looking to unlock new job growth opportunities, Standard Chartered Bank is the place for you. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 11 million clients in many of the world’s fastest-growing markets. Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.
r: Conduct market research to understand customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape with respect to Products and Solutions (Structured Products and other CMPS Products as may be assigned)
Analyse data to identify opportunities and threats.
Develop a clear product vision that aligns with the bank's overall strategy and goals.
Create and maintain a product roadmap that outlines the key features, timelines, and milestones.
Communicate product strategy, progress, and changes effectively to all stakeholders.
Drive new business and strategic initiatives across different business segments within Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB)
Business owner in all related product platform
Drive platform usage, client penetration efforts.
Accountable for delivery of all product enhancements, project deliveries in terms of championing as business lead
Manage operations, IT and middle office resources indirectly in terms of driving changes, delivery and strategy.
Responsible for overseeing end to end product process through the product life cycle, including all risk management initiatives.
Owns and responsible for Country Product Programme/Addendum and ensure alignment to the Group Product Programme
Ensure compliance to internal and external governance standards and regulatory requirements.
Participate in audits, manage regulatory incidents and communications on product and drive the process, product and system changes to minimise regulatory breaches.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.
